preserve: Map 4/visible scene 3 world-anchored tunnel optical flow
Map 5/visible scene 4 bridge-last occlusion and max two signs

current_candidate.summary: Spaces v34 preserves v33 visuals and adds a deterministic visual-review harness. The lab now supports review=1 with map/x/z/t query parameters, fixed camera/animation state and hidden UI. A GitHub Actions workflow captures desktop/mobile evidence for all visible scenes plus three tower-depth samples, publishes a contact sheet + manifest, and writes a stable current-review.json pointer so future visual iterations can inspect actual screenshots instead of relying on syntax/SHA checks alone.

open_feedback: Automated review now works end-to-end and no longer requires the user to upload a screenshot.
TORRES automated screenshots immediately confirm the current visual is still bad: the deck projects as a large purple triangular wedge despite roadHalf=.18.
TORRES towers still read as giant segmented tubes/walls rather than believable megabuildings; horizontal shading bands and extreme screen occupancy dominate.
Neon facade lights read as isolated pixels, blade signs look pasted onto the tower surface, and the cyan orbital ring reads as a broken floating arc rather than integrated signage.
Do not change ARCOS or CALZADA without new explicit feedback; automated review confirms their current compositions are coherent with the user's accepted direction.
Tunnel capture confirms near/far depth is working; future tunnel work should focus on texture quality, not geometry.

review_pipeline.trigger_rule: After a Spaces visual edit is published, advance visual-review-spaces to the exact source commit. This isolates screenshot capture from the repo's main-branch workflow storm.
